question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Coffee was too __hot__; it burnt my tongue.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Frigid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hot"** means having a high temperature. (गर्म)

 
 
• **Example: **The soup is hot, be careful when you eat it.
 
 
 
• **"Frigid"** refers to something extremely cold. (ठंडा)
 
 
• **Example: **The water in the pool was frigid, so I didn't swim.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'hot'** is **'frigid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Frigid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Scorching **(झुलसा देने वाला): Extremely hot.

 
 
• **Example:** The scorching sun made it hard to stay outside for long.
 
 
 
• **Balmy **(सुहावना): Pleasantly warm.
 
 
• **Example: **We enjoyed the balmy evening by the beach.
 
 
 
• **Subtle** (सूक्ष्म): Not obvious; delicate or precise.
 
 
• **Example:** Her subtle hint did not go unnoticed.
